005package org.wpilib.vision.apriltag;
006
007import io.avaje.jsonb.Json;
008import io.avaje.jsonb.Jsonb;
009import java.io.IOException;
010import java.io.InputStream;
011import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
012import java.nio.file.Files;
013import java.nio.file.Path;
014import java.util.ArrayList;
015import java.util.HashMap;
016import java.util.List;
017import java.util.Map;
018import java.util.Objects;
019import java.util.Optional;
020import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Pose3d;
021import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation3d;
022import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Translation3d;
023
024/**
025 * Class for representing a layout of AprilTags on a field and reading them from a JSON format.
026 *
027 * <p>The JSON format contains two top-level objects, "tags" and "field". The "tags" object is a
028 * list of all AprilTags contained within a layout. Each AprilTag serializes to a JSON object
029 * containing an ID and a Pose3d. The "field" object is a descriptor of the size of the field in
030 * meters with "width" and "length" values. This is to account for arbitrary field sizes when
031 * transforming the poses.
032 *
033 * <p>Pose3ds in the JSON are measured using the normal FRC coordinate system, NWU with the origin
034 * at the bottom-right corner of the blue alliance wall. {@link #setOrigin(OriginPosition)} can be
035 * used to change the poses returned from {@link AprilTagFieldLayout#getTagPose(int)} to be from the
036 * perspective of a specific alliance.
037 *
038 * <p>Tag poses represent the center of the tag, with a zero rotation representing a tag that is
039 * upright and facing away from the (blue) alliance wall (that is, towards the opposing alliance).
040 */
041@Json
042public class AprilTagFieldLayout {
043  /** Common origin positions for the AprilTag coordinate system. */
044  public enum OriginPosition {
045    /** Blue alliance wall, right side. */
046    kBlueAllianceWallRightSide,
047    /** Red alliance wall, right side. */
048    kRedAllianceWallRightSide,
049  }
050
051  @Json.Ignore private final Map<Integer, AprilTag> m_apriltags = new HashMap<>();
052
053  @Json.Property("field")
054  FieldDimensions m_fieldDimensions;
055
056  @Json.Ignore private Pose3d m_origin;
057
058  /**
059   * Construct a new AprilTagFieldLayout with values imported from a JSON file.
060   *
061   * @param path Path of the JSON file to import from.
062   * @throws IOException If reading from the file fails.
063   */
064  public AprilTagFieldLayout(String path) throws IOException {
065    this(Path.of(path));
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Construct a new AprilTagFieldLayout with values imported from a JSON file.
070   *
071   * @param path Path of the JSON file to import from.
072   * @throws IOException If reading from the file fails.
073   */
074  public AprilTagFieldLayout(Path path) throws IOException {
075    AprilTagFieldLayout layout =
076        Jsonb.instance().type(AprilTagFieldLayout.class).fromJson(Files.newBufferedReader(path));
077    m_apriltags.putAll(layout.m_apriltags);
078    m_fieldDimensions = layout.m_fieldDimensions;
079    setOrigin(OriginPosition.kBlueAllianceWallRightSide);
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Construct a new AprilTagFieldLayout from a list of {@link AprilTag} objects.
084   *
085   * @param apriltags List of {@link AprilTag}.
086   * @param fieldLength Length of the field the layout is representing in meters.
087   * @param fieldWidth Width of the field the layout is representing in meters.
088   */
089  public AprilTagFieldLayout(List<AprilTag> apriltags, double fieldLength, double fieldWidth) {
090    this(apriltags, new FieldDimensions(fieldLength, fieldWidth));
091  }
092
093  @Json.Creator
094  AprilTagFieldLayout(
095      @Json.Alias("tags") List<AprilTag> apriltags,
096      @Json.Alias("field") FieldDimensions fieldDimensions) {
097    // To ensure the underlying semantics don't change with what kind of list is passed in
098    for (AprilTag tag : apriltags) {
099      m_apriltags.put(tag.ID, tag);
100    }
101    m_fieldDimensions = fieldDimensions;
102    setOrigin(OriginPosition.kBlueAllianceWallRightSide);
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * Returns a List of the {@link AprilTag AprilTags} used in this layout.
107   *
108   * @return The {@link AprilTag AprilTags} used in this layout.
109   */
110  @Json.Property("tags")
111  public List<AprilTag> getTags() {
112    return new ArrayList<>(m_apriltags.values());
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Returns the length of the field the layout is representing in meters.
117   *
118   * @return length, in meters
119   */
120  public double getFieldLength() {
121    return m_fieldDimensions.fieldLength;
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Returns the length of the field the layout is representing in meters.
126   *
127   * @return width, in meters
128   */
129  public double getFieldWidth() {
130    return m_fieldDimensions.fieldWidth;
131  }
132
133  /**
134   * Sets the origin based on a predefined enumeration of coordinate frame origins. The origins are
135   * calculated from the field dimensions.
136   *
137   * <p>This transforms the Pose3d objects returned by {@link #getTagPose(int)} to return the
138   * correct pose relative to a predefined coordinate frame.
139   *
140   * @param origin The predefined origin
141   */
142  public final void setOrigin(OriginPosition origin) {
143    var pose =
144        switch (origin) {
145          case kBlueAllianceWallRightSide -> Pose3d.kZero;
146          case kRedAllianceWallRightSide ->
147              new Pose3d(
148                  new Translation3d(m_fieldDimensions.fieldLength, m_fieldDimensions.fieldWidth, 0),
149                  new Rotation3d(0, 0, Math.PI));
150        };
151    setOrigin(pose);
152  }
153
154  /**
155   * Sets the origin for tag pose transformation.
156   *
157   * <p>This transforms the Pose3d objects returned by {@link #getTagPose(int)} to return the
158   * correct pose relative to the provided origin.
159   *
160   * @param origin The new origin for tag transformations
161   */
162  public final void setOrigin(Pose3d origin) {
163    m_origin = origin;
164  }
165
166  /**
167   * Returns the origin used for tag pose transformation.
168   *
169   * @return the origin
170   */
171  public Pose3d getOrigin() {
172    return m_origin;
173  }
174
175  /**
176   * Gets an AprilTag pose by its ID.
177   *
178   * @param ID The ID of the tag.
179   * @return The pose corresponding to the ID passed in or an empty optional if a tag with that ID
180   *     was not found.
181   */
182  @SuppressWarnings("ParameterName")
183  public Optional<Pose3d> getTagPose(int ID) {
184    AprilTag tag = m_apriltags.get(ID);
185    if (tag == null) {
186      return Optional.empty();
187    }
188    return Optional.of(tag.pose.relativeTo(m_origin));
189  }
190
191  /**
192   * Serializes a AprilTagFieldLayout to a JSON file.
193   *
194   * @param path The path to write to.
195   * @throws IOException If writing to the file fails.
196   */
197  public void serialize(String path) throws IOException {
198    serialize(Path.of(path));
199  }
200
201  /**
202   * Serializes a AprilTagFieldLayout to a JSON file.
203   *
204   * @param path The path to write to.
205   * @throws IOException If writing to the file fails.
206   */
207  public void serialize(Path path) throws IOException {
208    Jsonb.instance().type(AprilTagFieldLayout.class).toJson(this, Files.newBufferedWriter(path));
209  }
210
211  /**
212   * Get an official {@link AprilTagFieldLayout}.
213   *
214   * @param field The loadable AprilTag field layout.
215   * @return AprilTagFieldLayout of the field.
216   * @throws UncheckedIOException If the layout does not exist.
217   */
218  public static AprilTagFieldLayout loadField(AprilTagFields field) {
219    if (field.fieldLayout == null) {
220      try {
221        field.fieldLayout = loadFromResource(field.resourceFile);
222      } catch (IOException e) {
223        throw new UncheckedIOException(
224            "Could not load AprilTagFieldLayout from " + field.resourceFile, e);
225      }
226    }
227    // Copy layout because the layout's origin is mutable
228    return new AprilTagFieldLayout(
229        field.fieldLayout.getTags(),
230        field.fieldLayout.getFieldLength(),
231        field.fieldLayout.getFieldWidth());
232  }
233
234  /**
235   * Deserializes a field layout from a resource within a internal jar file.
236   *
237   * <p>Users should use {@link #loadField(AprilTagFields)} to load official layouts and {@link
238   * #AprilTagFieldLayout(String)} for custom layouts.
239   *
240   * @param resourcePath The absolute path of the resource
241   * @return The deserialized layout
242   * @throws IOException If the resource could not be loaded
243   */
244  public static AprilTagFieldLayout loadFromResource(String resourcePath) throws IOException {
245    try (InputStream stream = AprilTagFieldLayout.class.getResourceAsStream(resourcePath)) {
246      if (stream == null) {
247        // Class.getResourceAsStream() returns null if the resource does not exist.
248        throw new IOException("Could not locate resource: " + resourcePath);
249      }
250      return Jsonb.instance().type(AprilTagFieldLayout.class).fromJson(stream);
251    }
252  }
253
254  @Override
255  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
256    return obj instanceof AprilTagFieldLayout layout
257        && m_apriltags.equals(layout.m_apriltags)
258        && m_origin.equals(layout.m_origin);
259  }
260
261  @Override
262  public int hashCode() {
263    return Objects.hash(m_apriltags, m_origin);
264  }
265
266  static class FieldDimensions {
267    @Json.Property(value = "length")
268    public final double fieldLength;
269
270    @Json.Property(value = "width")
271    public final double fieldWidth;
272
273    @Json.Creator()
274    FieldDimensions(
275        @Json.Alias(value = "length") double fieldLength,
276        @Json.Alias(value = "width") double fieldWidth) {
277      this.fieldLength = fieldLength;
278      this.fieldWidth = fieldWidth;
279    }
280  }
281}
